papers.title: Self-Reflective Reasoning in Large Language Models for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: Autonomous scientific exploration requires artificial reasoning systems to actively formulate hypotheses, generate predictive tests, and iteratively falsify conjectures against empirical benchmarks without constant human steering. We present Meta-Reflect, an architecture incorporating iterative critic validation loops against open science benchmarks.
papers.methodology: Dual-model agentic loop with symbolic consistency checks and automated counterfactual verification evaluated across 4,200 open chemistry and molecular biology challenge sets.
papers.findings: Achieves a 38.4% improvement in multi-step hypothesis generation accuracy over baseline zero-shot reasoning. Eliminates 71% of non-convergent synthetic pathways.
papers.limitations: Inference token consumption increases ~4.2x due to recursive verification branches. Internal critic occasionally converges onto plausible-sounding circular proofs in adversarial physics proofs.
papers.extractedText: Full benchmark text available in system archive. Evaluated with temperature=0.2 and top_p=0.95 across distributed clusters.

papers.title: Targeted Epigenetic Editing using Engineered CRISPR-dCas9 Repressors in Primary Neurons
papers.abstract: Precise gene silencing without double-strand DNA breaks is imperative for therapeutics targeting neurodegenerative conditions. Here we detail a compact dCas9-KRAB-MeCP2 transcriptional repressor delivered via AAV9 that achieves durable repression across neuronal cell lines.
papers.methodology: AAV-mediated delivery to human iPSC-derived cortical neurons; single-cell RNA-seq and targeted bisulfite sequencing arrays at days 7, 21, and 60 post-transduction.
papers.sampleSize: n = 18 biological replicates per lineage across 3 distinct human iPSC lines
papers.findings: 92% locus-specific silencing sustained over 60 days in vitro with zero detectable off-target chromosomal translocations or cytotoxic gene signatures.
papers.limitations: Vector packaging size constraints (AAV <4.7kb limit) restrict multi-guide multiplexing in vivo; delivery efficiency drops significantly in mature deep cortical layers.
papers.extractedText: Experimental protocols conducted under biosafety level 2 compliance. Primary cortical tissues sourced under institutional ethical board approval #2022-819.

papers.title: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces (Mamba-2 Architecture)
papers.abstract: Structured State Space Models (SSMs) provide sub-quadratic scaling for sequential tasks. We demonstrate that selective SSMs match or exceed Transformers across long-context benchmarks while maintaining linear compute and memory complexity.
papers.methodology: Hardware-aware associative scan algorithms optimized for SRAM utilization on modern GPU tensor cores, scaling from 130M to 2.8B parameter models.
papers.sampleSize: Models scaled up to 2.8B parameters trained over 300B tokens
papers.findings: Achieves 5x inference throughput acceleration while sustaining linear memory scaling across 32k context windows without degradation on language modeling perplexity.
papers.limitations: Subtle performance degradation on high-density associative retrieval and multi-needle search tasks compared to full attention.
papers.extractedText: Evaluation code and checkpoints released under Apache 2.0 license.
